content.caption: Mission Impossible: The Great Kibble Heist. 🐾 Mibao has finally breached the perimeter of the forbidden ceramic bowl. The stakes have never been higher.
content.scene: A hand-painted book illustration of Mibao, a tiny brown tabby kitten with hazel eyes, mid-air leap. She is lunging heroically toward a single, solitary piece of kibble resting on a vast, polished wooden floor. Natural evening light catches her white chin as she executes a dramatic, clumsy belly flop toward her prize.
